## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: In a cloud container with an OpenRouter credential provisioned as an...

The system SHALL ensure that in a cloud container with an OpenRouter credential provisioned as an environment secret, converge() reaches min_quorum=2 for PLAN_REVIEW using claude_code plus at least one OpenRouter lane from a different model family, verified end to end on a fixture change.

#### Scenario: In a cloud container with an OpenRouter credential provisioned as an...

WHEN `openrouter-review-lane` is implemented
THEN In a cloud container with an OpenRouter credential provisioned as an environment secret, converge() reaches min_quorum=2 for PLAN_REVIEW using claude_code plus at least one OpenRouter lane from a different model family, verified end to end on a fixture change.

### Requirement: Lane availability is established by a dry invocation of the lane for the...

The system SHALL ensure that lane availability is established by a dry invocation of the lane for the requested mode and reported in execution_profile; no worker reads environment variables or credentials to discover it, and --check-vendors no longer reports a lane that cannot dispatch.

#### Scenario: Lane availability is established by a dry invocation of the lane for the...

WHEN `openrouter-review-lane` is implemented
THEN Lane availability is established by a dry invocation of the lane for the requested mode and reported in execution_profile; no worker reads environment variables or credentials to discover it, and --check-vendors no longer reports a lane that cannot dispatch.

### Requirement: Every OpenRouter review records model, generation id and cost against the...

The system SHALL ensure that every OpenRouter review records model, generation id and cost against the existing monthly spend ceiling; exceeding the ceiling parks with capability_unavailable instead of silently dropping to single-vendor review.

#### Scenario: Every OpenRouter review records model, generation id and cost against the...

WHEN `openrouter-review-lane` is implemented
THEN Every OpenRouter review records model, generation id and cost against the existing monthly spend ceiling; exceeding the ceiling parks with capability_unavailable instead of silently dropping to single-vendor review.

### Requirement: OpenRouter findings conform to review-findings.schema.json and are...

The system SHALL ensure that openRouter findings conform to review-findings.schema.json and are synthesized by ConsensusSynthesizer like CLI lanes, with vendor attribution preserved in the ledger.

#### Scenario: OpenRouter findings conform to review-findings.schema.json and are...

WHEN `openrouter-review-lane` is implemented
THEN OpenRouter findings conform to review-findings.schema.json and are synthesized by ConsensusSynthesizer like CLI lanes, with vendor attribution preserved in the ledger.

### Requirement: The "Review quorum in cloud containers (temporary)" section of...

The system SHALL ensure that the "Review quorum in cloud containers (temporary)" section of TRUST_POSTURE.md is removed once the lane passes in cloud, restoring quorum 2 everywhere, and review_requirements expresses any remaining per-environment exception as data with a sunset.

#### Scenario: The "Review quorum in cloud containers (temporary)" section of...

WHEN `openrouter-review-lane` is implemented
THEN The "Review quorum in cloud containers (temporary)" section of TRUST_POSTURE.md is removed once the lane passes in cloud, restoring quorum 2 everywhere, and review_requirements expresses any remaining per-environment exception as data with a sunset.
